name: Vspomnit' vsjo
source:
What do you do if your life starts with a clean slate?
If you remember neither your parents, nor your friends, nor your favorite song?
Will you be able to start a new life, or will you choose to Remember everything?
translation:
如果你的生活从头开始，你会做什么？
如果你既不记得你的父母，也不记得你的朋友，也不记得你最喜欢的歌曲？
你能开始新的生活，还是选择记住一切？
